raw_discovery_candidates.name: Builder Program business: builder fees, weekly rewards, grants, gasless relayer
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Ship a trading front end, bot or terminal that stamps a builderCode on user orders and charge up to 100 bps taker / 50 bps maker on notional, plus volume-based weekly USDC rewards and grants.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Since CLOB V2 (2026-04-28) the builder code is a signed field of the order and is attributed on-chain at match. Builders set a flat fee in 1 bp steps up to 100 bps on taker and 50 bps on maker notional, additive to platform fees; fees are computed at match, settled through CTFExchangeV2 and accrued to the builder wallet; a rate can change once per 7 days with 3 days notice and is publicly queryable. Tiers: Unverified (100 relayer tx/day), Verified (10,000/day, leaderboard, Telegram, weekly USDC rewards subject to approval), Partner (unlimited). All tiers get the gasless relayer for wallet deployment, approvals, split/merge/redeem and order execution. The Bridge API accepts X-Builder-Code on deposits and withdrawals (2026-06-25) and Combos can be routed through a Builder Gateway. The official leaderboard shows one-month volumes of $90.0M (Betmoar), $54.6M (Gate), $53.4M (traderline), $26.2M (SpreadCore), $25.4M (MetaMask) and 50+ projects; the site advertises over $2.5M in grants and weekly volume rewards since Nov 2.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Distribution and tooling rather than prediction skill: fee revenue scales with other people's volume and is indifferent to who wins.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: A team already building agent infrastructure (copy trading, alerts, execution) can expose it as a product; 10 bps on $20M/month is $20k/month with no market risk, and the relayer removes gas cost from its own arb bots.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Most users are fee-sensitive and competing front ends charge 0 bps; builder fees are additive so they worsen users' execution; weekly rewards and grants are discretionary and their size is unpublished; omnibus-wallet integrations lose taker rebates and referral eligibility; geo-compliance duty sits with the builder.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Register an Unverified builder code, route a closed beta of 20 users through it, measure retained monthly volume per user and price sensitivity at 0/10/25 bps before applying for Verified.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Builder codes can be disabled for fraudulent, deceptive, misleading, automated, self-referred or other non-bona fide trading activity. Serving restricted jurisdictions (30+ now block Polymarket) exposes the builder, not only the user.

Partners attach a vendor fee to each order through CreateVendorOrder as a fixed non-negative USD amount computed under their own customer agreement; the exchange records it, accrues it as a receivable against the participant's cash, produces a daily vendor-fee report, and the partner collects by transfer (reason VENDOR_FEES) at most once per day per account. This is the regulated analogue of international builder fees, aimed at front ends, bots-as-a-service and brokers serving US customers. Polymarket's affiliate has also applied for an FCM licence to offer margin, which would widen what partners can sell.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Compliance burden (IB registration, KYC liability, reconciliation duties); long onboarding; US state-level actions against prediction markets (Minnesota ban, Nevada/Massachusetts/Kentucky actions); banking fragility (JPMorgan cut ties in August 2026).
